title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
BTC Dominance +3.3% (24h) → 59.3% — alts underperforming as BTC holds $77,112; cycle reads BTC Accumulation.
Gold +2.2% (24h) → $4,619 — rising as US 10yr yield rebounds to 4.71% (Treasury long-end buyback doubled).
Walmart −9% (Aug 20): US comp sales +2.6% vs +3.8% exp — consumer bellwether miss, $83B market cap lost.
Week-ahead watch: PCE Aug 26 + Warsh inaugural Jackson Hole keynote Aug 28 — highest-volatility window of August.
